You can make 1~2% table beer really quickly and it tastes pretty refreshing. You take a bag of about 2kilo of malted barley or similar grain, you steep it for about a half hour then bring to a gentle boil still inside the cloth bag. Remove the bag and keep the liquid. Bring the liquid to a boil for about one hour more and if you have some malt you can add it at the start of this final boil. Transfer to a sterile container and keep in a cool dry place for a few days and you've got beer. Keep it for longer and depending on how sterile your container is it will keep getting stronger. After 2 weeks it should be about 4~5% but you run the risk of it being contaminated and going bad if you don't have some hops involved.

Real simple, real easy to make and something every single home did in Europe for centuries.
